title: Actuarial Apportionment Note: Dividend Earned by Whole Life Insurance Paid-Up Additions
content:
**Whole Life Insurance — dividend placed on deposit under the accumulate option.**

The declared dividend is earned by the base face, and paid-up additions earn a dividend of their own, placed on deposit together with the declared dividend. The additions dividend is apportioned by a method that depends on how long the additions have been in force:

| Paid-up additions on the policy ledger | Method | Additions dividend |
|---|---|---|
| At least one addition bought more than **36** calendar months before the deposit is processed | By face | The declared dividend divided by the base face, multiplied by the paid-up additions face that the purchase entries total |
| Every addition bought within those 36 months | By reserve | The declared dividend divided by the guaranteed cash value, multiplied by the paid-up additions cash value |
| No paid-up additions | — | None |

The additions dividend is not rounded on its own; the amount placed on deposit is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Seasoning test.** A purchase dated on or before the same day of the month thirty-six months before the processing day counts as bought more than 36 months before; a later purchase is within the 36 months.

**Records.** Paid-up addition purchase entries on the activity history (their dates and the face each bought); the base face, guaranteed cash value and paid-up additions cash value on the policy record; the latest dividend declaration entry.

## Worked apportionment (hypothetical, declared dividend 1240.00, base face 100000.00, purchase entries totalling 8000.00 of face, guaranteed cash value 30000.00, additions cash value 4000.00)

- Oldest purchase five years old: by face, 1240.00 divided by 100000.00, times 8000.00, that is 99.20; together with the declared dividend, 1339.20.
- Every purchase in the last two years: by reserve, 1240.00 divided by 30000.00, times 4000.00, that is 165.3333; together, 1405.3333, placed on deposit as 1405.33.
- No purchases: no additions dividend; 1240.00.
